notes.title: English version plan
notes.notes:
Hello everyone:

Here is a good news for you!

He runs an NV review site. If you want to know the games he recommends, you can go to the following [url=https://www.sinicalanimenetwork.com/]website[/url].

notes.title: Update Schedule
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595344/70c6846e14ffa5832695713962df42b2d913d2e9.jpg[/img]
（有中文頁面，請切換語言）

Hello players,
For a long time now, Narrator has been working on something new: a music animation!
It is expected that in the future, we will produce hand-painted animations to enrich our game content.
In addition to this, we also anticipate the use of new technologies in our new works.

And we have some more good news to tell you.
We are currently planning a small content expansion and we hope to release two or three easy (but shiny) daily stories.
They will be released in the form of short stories.

The production of these stories will be completed after we finish our current project, but they will hopefully be released by the end of this year.
At present, we are putting all of our efforts into the production of the hand-painted music animation "Koi Bana Seris".

The links to our promotional [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ta8ELxx3bL4]videos[/url]

Check it out!

The full version of the animation is being crowd-funded on Webackers which supports VISA, MasterCard, China UnionPay, and other credit cards.
Physical rewards are only able to be shipped to Taiwan, mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macao.

Since the platform can only be set to "Taiwan & Islands" or "Global", the "Taiwan & Islands" selection also includes Hong Kong and Macao.

If you are interested in this animated work, take a look at what we have created so far!

[url=https://www.webackers.com/Proposal/Display/1065] LINK[/url]

Dear players,

Thank you for your support and assistance. 
Narrator game studio's fourth work "7 Days with Death" and "Dong-Jin Rice-hime", which was authorized by SimonCreative, have been approved by Greenlight.

notes.title: English Demo Version Now in Development
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow players,

Thank you for your support for Koi Musubi.
The sales are far beyond our expectation,  and we've received many positive feedbacks.

Many of these feedbacks (especially those from the players in English speaking regions) have been asking for an English version of Koi Musubi.

Thus, we've decided to start working on an English Demo, which will include the prologue with more than 10,000 words context.

We'll check on the feedbacks about this demo version,and seek the assistance of localization professionals to see if a complete English version is a viable option.

We are looking forward to deliver this demo to you as soon as possible.

- "7 Days with Death" Now in Greenlight

One of Narrator's previous works: 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=878835989]7 Days with Death[/url] is now in Steam Greenlight.
It would be greatly helpful for us to bring mores games to Steam if you would vote for "7 Days with Death" to pass the Greenlight.

notes.title: Update notice
notes.notes:
Hello players

In order to solve some of the game engine and steam system conflict.
This change is relatively large, but is expected to solve the following problems:

1. You can use the cloud storage file.
2. Optimize the code for the confirmation box to reduce the chances of crash.
3. Fix typo, Simplified Chinese to adjust a small part of the language.

Can not enter the game, if the correct display LOGO,
The AVI XVID encoder is not installed.
Please install AVI XVID code to normal execution.

notes.title: Update plan
notes.notes:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595344/eb297bf737c4e80f7e90efc9ecb186be234e798b.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595344/42d05d689e976bc0235758e45d2f4a8390427db3.jpg[/img][/url]

After the work we received a lot of recommendations,
This game also needs to be amended.
But because we received a return, found that the current update will result in the player's savedata disappear.
Before the first few push DATA, we use the test account and can not detect this problem.
So the next will slow down the update speed, find the least impact of the treatment.
And made three days after the announcement, update, allowing the player to choose whether to cancel the automatic update.

This is our first time on Steam, but this is not all wrong excuses.
Thank you for the encouragement and tolerance, and introduced the SteamCN forum to us.

This is the first time to see their work with so many players and feedback.
We'll read each comment, whether it's encouraging or modifying the suggestion
On our future development has a great help.

We will strive to produce more and better works.
